about_the_game:
This demo allows you to try Simulo in both singleplayer and multiplayer. You can do incredible things like build contraptions with electricity or something.

Saving is disabled for the demo, and the multiplayer is buggy in this version (but more stable in our more work-in-progress versions)

This demo is only available for a limited time! On October 27, it will be delisted.
detailed_description:
